overview: Series showcase: The Deep Homestead scenario and Hub health in Mod Options. The canonical Azrael storyteller still ships with Homesteader.
Open Mod Options to see which series mods are loaded, whether their bridges are intact, and what you would have to clear before taking one out.

features.title: Series health
features.body: Mod Options inventories the loaded series mods, their build stamps, and Harmony failures. That scan builds once each time you open settings.

features.title: Load order
features.body: The hub warns when a series mod loads after Azrael. Azrael is meant to load last so it can see the others.

features.title: Sister bridges
features.body: It checks the live Nemesis to Deep Colony epitaph hook, and only mentions Deep Colony hediffs when a pawn actually has one.

features.title: A report, not a save edit
features.body: Each loaded series mod can open a report of its buildings, items, caravan cargo, and blockers. Queued deconstruction does not rewrite the save.

features.title: What blocks uninstall
features.body: An active or truced Nemesis hunt, colonists still on a Strata floor, Deep Colony family letters, and a parked Nemesis world pawn show up in the report.

features.title: Showcase start
features.body: The Deep Homestead scenario is the series start. Start a new game for the scenario. The storyteller itself is safe to add to an existing save.

features.title: Storyteller stays with Homesteader
features.body: The Azrael storyteller is packaged with Homesteader. Sibling scenarios lock it when Homesteader is loaded.

notes: Safe to add mid-save for the storyteller. Start a new game for The Deep Homestead scenario.
Chinese Simplified and Russian include the scenario and hub strings.

overview: Off-map faction life: other settlements drift, flip ownership, feud, and make news — without a second storyteller dumping threat at you.
Personal antagonists stay in Nemesis. Player goodwill stays in Deep Colony. Living World is the chronicle of everyone else.

features.title: World history
features.body: The Chronicle tab keeps what the world did, with faction and hear-channel filters. Click a row to move the world camera to that tile.

features.title: Rumours
features.body: News from far away can arrive wrong. A later entry corrects it in the chronicle.

features.title: Big news still lands
features.body: A faction that loses its last settlement gets a collapse letter. When a settlement's prosperity slides into struggle, a distinct famine rumour goes out. Those major letters are not dropped to make room for smaller ones.

features.title: Miles on the map
features.body: After your caravans have walked eight unique tiles, the road notices. Every fourth new tile on a stretch you already walked can found a way-camp: an easier overnight rest, not a settlement.

features.title: Road-worn
features.body: A long-running caravan can pick up road-worn: a little faster on the march, fading over a season.

features.title: Route hazards
features.body: Mud, heat, cold, or wind can sit on tiles you already walked. Way-camps make that rarer. Rest and food take a hit; road-worn pawns take less. Toggle it in Mod Options.

features.title: They change without you
features.body: NPC settlements drift, change hands, and feud on their own clock. A morph only spends the yearly budget when it actually happens.

features.title: Not your threat meter
features.body: This is news and movement off your map. It does not add a second storyteller's raid budget.

notes: Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save.
Nemesis still owns a named antagonist. Deep Colony still owns your goodwill ledger.

worksWith.name: Deep Colony
worksWith.note: Living World can hand decisive victories, betrayals, and refugee flights to Deep Colony's goodwill ledger. Missing Deep Colony is a no-op.

worksWith.name: Nemesis
worksWith.note: A personal hunt stays in Nemesis. Living World does not invent a second antagonist.
